title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1110 | 鸡块救小猫、巨型橡皮筋球、火星红宝石
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🐱 纽约一只小猫掉进下水道，救援人员用鸡块把它引了出来，还给它取名“鸡块”！
🎈 底特律一位大叔花了十一年，做出一个重达一万多磅的世界最大橡皮筋球！
💎 火星车在火星岩石里发现了红宝石家族的矿物，火星可能藏着亮晶晶的宝藏！

📖 Word of the day: rescue（救援；救出）

🎮 谜语时间：我会拉长、会弹跳，由成千上万个小圈圈卷成一个大球——我是谁？答案：橡皮筋！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🐱 A kitten fell into a storm drain in New York, and rescuers lured him out with chicken nuggets, then named him Chicken Nugget!
🎈 A man in Detroit spent eleven years building the biggest rubber band ball in the world, as heavy as an elephant!
💎 A Mars rover found ruby-family minerals in Martian rocks — Mars may be hiding sparkly treasure!

📖 Word of the day: rescue

🎮 Riddle time: I stretch and snap, I bounce and boing, I am made of thousands of tiny loops rolled into one giant ball — what am I? A rubber band!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. rescue（救援；救出）
to save someone from danger and bring them to safety
例：The chicken nuggets helped rescue the kitten!（鸡块帮忙救出了小猫！）

2. bounce（弹跳）
to jump up and down, like a ball
例：Can I bounce on the giant rubber band ball?（我能在巨大的橡皮筋球上弹跳吗？）

3. ruby（红宝石）
a bright red jewel
例：The Mars rover found ruby minerals on Mars!（火星车在火星上发现了红宝石矿物！）

4. mineral（矿物）
a natural material found in rocks
例：Corundum is a mineral, and rubies are made of it!（刚玉是一种矿物，红宝石就是由它组成的！）
